    Incidence tables with zero relations #

    For Case 2 of Lemma 8.11 (local-ray-geometry.tex) the paper uses a tree category with one zero relation (F = 1 in Lemma 8.8). Here: the incidence table of a finite poset with a set Z of comparable pairs declared zero, closed under extension (incZ), and configurations of it in a ray table (ConfZ), which make its linearization representation-finite when kP is (Lemmas 8.9 and C.1 as in TableConf).
